headline: Xiaomi gets it wrong: profits fall 42%, yet it accelerates its investment in the most expensive market in the world
summary: Xiaomi's profits fell 42%, while the company accelerates its investment in a new generation of chips. The move comes amid a component crisis and inflation.
why: Xiaomi is a major Chinese smartphone and consumer electronics maker. Its margins and chip investment strategy affect the component supply chain and rival smartphone vendors.

impacts.name: Xiaomi
impacts.why: A 42% profit decline directly reflects weaker earnings at the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
